notes: Per Form 1098-E, one class from the form's current answers. The class is not taken from statement-line21-standing. none is the only favorable value: an older yes with no loan-link facts, one clean inclusion beside an older yes, an older yes that covers a withdrawal, a denial, or missing detail, and a newer form whose own standing is none. An older no publishes older-no and assumes no cause. A form with neither the older answer nor a loan-link fact blocks. A contradiction, an unresolved answer, a replay marker, a financing denial, a mix of unresolved and lacks, or a contrary answer on an open or withdrawn inclusion is named and is not favorable. The last branch is unclassified-not-supported, never none.
